query: Trump job approval poll this week

results.content: A new Economist/YouGov poll, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025.
results.title: What is Trump's approval rating in Tennessee? What August polls say

results.title: Trump approval falls to new low as voters say U.S. is 'out of control"

results.content:
Trump has traditionally seen universal approval among self-identified Republicans, though in this poll there is some minor attrition among his own party (12% disapprove). However, the heart of his current job approval woes is Trump’s standing with Independents, 70% of which disapprove of the job he’s doing – with strong disapproval reaching 65%.
